preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 50000 inclusive.

preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of elements N in arrays A and B is between 2 and 500000 inclusive.

preconditions.description: Each element in arrays A and B for all test cases is between 1 and 100000 inclusive.

preconditions.description: The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 500000.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) for result in results)
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is an integer.
